provider: CIESIN / NASA SEDAC GPWv4.11, Stanford Natural Capital Project mirror
processing: Arithmetic mean of valid native 30-arcsecond densities in 60×60 blocks; no overview use, no nodata-to-zero, no population totals computed.
limitations: Density screening preview, not a land-area-weighted or count-conserving aggregate. Small settlements and coastal partial cells need original data.
